description.value: micro bar + bites is a 900-square-foot tapas bar and cocktail lounge in downtown Kelowna, built around a horseshoe-shaped reclaimed-wood bar and known for creative stirred cocktails, rotating draught craft beer, and a seasonally changing small-plate tapas menu. Opened in 2014, it has grown into a well-regarded local institution with a strong community focus, live music nights, and knowledgeable bar staff. A touring cyclist looking for an elevated, locally rooted food-and-drink stop in the heart of Kelowna's waterfront district will find a lively and welcoming atmosphere here.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at microkelowna.com confirms this is an active tapas bar and cocktail lounge at 1500 Water St, Kelowna, with phone (778) 484-3500; OSM had no address or phone to cross-check. The tapas menu explicitly labels many items as GF (gluten-free) and VG (vegan), confirming dietary options. No mention of bike parking, washrooms, water refill, takeout, Wi-Fi, or device charging appears anywhere on the site, so those fields remain null.
concerns: Name mismatch: OSM records the business as 'Micro Bar' but the website consistently uses 'micro bar & bites' or 'micro bar + bites' as the full name.
19+ establishment — no minors permitted; relevant for family cycling groups.
No OSM address or phone to cross-check; contact details sourced entirely from website.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A well-established, actively operating tapas bar and cocktail lounge in downtown Kelowna; a legitimate food-and-drink stop for touring cyclists, though the 19+ (no minors) policy should be noted in the listing.
